text: Professional Definition: The Applied Chemistry major encompasses the fundamental knowledge, theories and skills of chemistry, and also involves related engineering and technical knowledge, including applied research and technology development, etc. It mainly studies how to transform the scientific research achievements and technological achievements in chemistry into practical applications, and widely permeate all aspects of life.Professional level and duration of study: It is an undergraduate major in regular institutions of higher learning in China, belonging to the category of chemistry. The general duration of study is four years, and it confers a Bachelor of Science degree or a Bachelor of Engineering degree.Professional development history: In 1952, China carried out departmental adjustments, and Applied Chemistry was no longer regarded as a major. However, a few institutions still retained or offered it. In 1963, The State Council approved and released the "General Professional Catalogue for Higher Education Institutions", re-establishing this major. Since then, with the development of science and technology, many colleges and universities have been established one after another. In 2012, the professional directory issued by the Ministry of Education clearly stated that it was a major under the category of science, belonging to the chemistry category.
